description:
Satoru Gojo — From Trend to Terror.
It starts light.
Reze and Gojo dancing side by side, following the viral rhythm.
For a moment, it feels playful… harmless.
Then everything shifts.
The smile fades.
Ryoiki Tenkai.
This edit flips a wholesome trend into pure dominance,
showing how Gojo’s aura can turn fun into fear in seconds.
A reminder that even in trends—
the strongest always decides the ending.
Don’t forget to subscribe ❤️
